about: Real frames of amendment M67 (D424): assign_damage refused and re-asked with a reason, then a legal split applied. Cut from the bridge frame log (var/games/human-ws-5/frames.jsonl) of tools/ws-assign-probe.mjs against the real engine, 2026-10-10, Forge 2.0.14 (forgeJarSha256 3c0a7c385b9207e593fe149255e00d1cd7e556809f138568d07e3828b78e5dd9). Read by web/test/assign-damage.test.ts and tools/llm-seat/test/assign-damage.test.mjs. docs/evidence/assign-probe.md is the run.

source.command: ./bridge/run.sh mtgtable.MtgTable --transport ws --port 8760 --seed 5 --deck decks/assign-probe.dck --ai-deck decks/blockers-probe.dck --games 4; node tools/ws-assign-probe.mjs --port 8760 --games 4

body.reason: Without trample, a blocked creature can't assign combat damage to Forge AI. Assign all 2 to the blockers.
Each blocker needs lethal damage before Forge AI gets any: Razorgrass Screen needs 1.
